title: ApprovalOutcome
description: How one approval step of a workflow run was decided: by the people who voted, by the workflow itself when it had no one to ask, or by an administrator who published without review. A run keeps its decisions in its variables under 'approvals'.

node.description: Name of the approval node that was decided.

decision.description: What the step decided. PartiallyApproved: reviewers published some of a change request's changes and dropped the rest. Overridden: an administrator published the change without review.

automaticReason.description: Why the workflow approved the step itself. Absent when people decided it.

decidedBy.description: Names of the users whose votes decided the step, or the administrator who overrode it. Empty when the workflow decided it.

decidedAt.description: Timestamp on which the step was decided.
